name: Luna in the Tavern
source:
Badass chick is drinking in a bar full of men. What could possibly go wrong?

Luna in the Tavern is a game where you'll be drinking and playing "Never Have I Ever" with guys in a tavern. 

As you play, you will meet Luna's five friends: Lyralei, Goodkind, Mirana, Lina, and Rylai, all of whom will provoke you to answer increasingly risky questions and do more and more lewd things. It's up to you to decide whether Luna will remain a strict warrior or act more freely and relax!

[From [url=https://titdang.itch.io/luna]itch.io[/url]]
